Declaration on Non-Blacklisting/Debarment: The bidder shall submit a declaration on a non-judicial stamp paper of Rs. 100/-, duly notarised. The date of the declaration shall not be earlier than the bid publication date. The declaration shall confirm that the bidder has not been debarred or blacklisted by any Bid Inviting Authority or any organisation functioning u nder the Central Government, State Government or Semi-Government. It shall also confirm that the bidde r is neither suspended nor under watch on the GeM Portal. The bidder's GeM Seller ID must be specifically mentioned in the affidavit. Failure to submit the required declaration shall result in rejection of the bid. 2. Solvency Certificate: The bidder shall submit a solvency certificate for Rs. 30,00,000/- (Rupees Thirty Lakh only) for each sched ule along with the bid. The certificate must be issued by a Nationalised/Scheduled Bank, should not be mo re than three months old as on the date of bid opening and must bear the valid Employee ID of the author ised bank official. 3. Electronic Performance Bank Guarantee (ePBG): Upon receipt of the confirmed order, the successful bidder shall furnish an Electronic Performance Bank G uarantee (ePBG) through a Nationalised/Scheduled Bank for an amount equivalent to 3% of the total contr act value. 4. Earnest Money Deposit (EMD): The bidder shall furnish an Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) of Rs. 75,000/- (Rupees Seventy-Five Thous and only) in the form of a Fixed Deposit Receipt (FDR), issued by a Nationalised/Scheduled Bank, in favour of GE UTILITY P&M, Delhi Cantt-10. The bidder shall upload a scanned copy of the FDR as proof of EMD submission along with the bid and ensure that the original hard copy is delivered to the Buyer bef ore the bid closing date/bid opening date. .
